annotation_scope: Codex automated development labels for all 156 frames, 720.000–725.167 seconds: a complete broadcast point from service close-up through wide-view exchanges, a dive and post-point context. Not an uninterrupted fixed-camera rally: view changes at frames 12 and 155; flight partly outside the inspected court crop and overlaps players. Approximate centers, uncertainty retained. Earlier sparse previews of model output had been seen; no evaluated predictions or interpolation supplied these labels. Not independent, blind, human-reviewed or held-out truth.
coordinate_method: Manual native-pixel centers from enlarged unmarked temporal sheets and local crops. Some centers may be refined by local bright-pixel measurements before evaluation. Labels cover visible components/streaks, not physical cork positions.
